# Advisory Goal Reflection Card

Subject: SEL and Advisory
Grade band: 6-8
Resource type: Reflection Card
NYS framework label: NYS SEL Benchmarks and local advisory goals

## Short Description
A weekly reflection card for academic, social, and personal goals in middle school advisory.

## Alignment Note
Supports self-management, reflection, goal setting, and student-adult check-ins.

## Classroom Use Case
Use every Friday in advisory and revisit during Monday goal setting.

## Preview Content
- Goal I worked on
- Evidence of progress
- Support I need next week

## Teacher Notes
This original StandardCraft resource is intended to support planning and classroom use. It is not issued by NYSED and does not replace district curriculum, local requirements, or teacher professional judgment.
